mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 8.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that triggers Fed rate cuts, boosting equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and increases in consumer credit (RSAFS) signal housing market weakness and credit tightening, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) signal monetary tightening combined with economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions with strong housing (HOUST > 550.0), residential construction supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 550.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 1-year windows.
